text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "If you read this Umatter post, misfortune will surely befall you within a week."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is this?! What a ridiculous prank.
As if I'd ever be fooled by something like this.

Satono Crown worried so much about the curse
that she ended up staying up late...
